summary: FBS Global Ltd, a Singapore-based foreign private issuer listed on a U.S. exchange, filed a Form 6-K disclosing an auditor change rather than a special situation. On September 29, 2026, the company dismissed NLA DFK Assurance PAC and engaged Assentsure PAC as its independent registered public accounting firm for fiscal year 2026, with audit committee and board approval. NLA's FY2025 report was unqualified. One reportable event was disclosed under Regulation S-K Item 304(a)(1)(v). No deal terms, shareholder stake, premium, advisor, or regulatory clock apply; no risk-arb angle exists.
